lines.en: label chapthree6:
scene newsummerstuff1
And so a new day of a new cycle begins.
I walked to school with the same girls I always walk to school with (Ami included again this time) and, for the most part, it was like nothing ever changed.
Well, nothing apart from Ayane’s newfound hobby of poking Maya’s buttons every chance she gets.
It’s all in good fun, though.
And to be frank, we kind of need it.
We almost lost someone the other night.
And no, I’m not just saying that because it’s Maya. I’d feel the same way about anyone in the class if they came to school the next day without any memories.
Which I guess says a lot about how much everyone cared about me in the beginning since...I went through that exact scenario.
But again, that’s fine.
And again, it’s all in good fun.
I’m sure this summer will be filled with plenty of that.
: Oh, Arakawa. Good morning.
scene newsummerstuff2
: Hey, Wakana. You look slightly less miserable than you normally do this morning.
: You look about the same.
: Handsome and mysterious?
: I was thinking something more along the lines of a low-grade eldritch horror. One mostly harmless, but still displeasing to look at.
: Oh.
: Well, fuck you too.
scene newsummerstuff3
: Where’s your sidekick?
: Which one? I have like ten now.
: Imani. I wanted to invite her to the bar with Osako and me tonight.
: Wait, really? I kind of figured she annoyed you based on the totally not racist “No Imani” sign she told me about yesterday.
scene newsummerstuff4
: Oh. Wow. Yeah, I...really didn’t even think of that.
: That’s not how she interpreted it, is it?
: I don’t think so. But still, why ban her from your room if you’re just going to go out looking for her instead of letting her come to you?
scene newsummerstuff5
: Because I know she is on the hunt for her own office and I refuse to give away the only location in this building that I can be comfortable in.
: So you sacrifice me instead?
: Is that not what friends are for? Sacrificing?
Today, I learned one more reason why Wakana doesn’t have many friends.
: No, Wakana. I don’t believe that’s what friends are for. But if I see her, I’ll tell her you’re looking for her.
scene newsummerstuff3
: Thanks. We don’t really know many people around our age. Not to mention ones who actually seem to have a mostly good head on their shoulders.
: You have me. How come you never invite me to the bar?
scene newsummerstuff5
: Who knows? Perhaps I think the testosterone would ruin the atmosphere?
: Besides, you’re older than us to begin with, aren’t you?
: Am I?
: I kind of just assumed that based on your demeanor and how fed up you are with life.
: If we judged people based on that alone, you’d likely be dead and buried right now.
scene newsummerstuff6
: Ah...and how wonderful that would be.
: I thought you weren’t allowed to say things like that anymore after the incident?
: Are you referring to the one where you left me for dead and didn’t even stop by to say hello?
: Are we really not past that yet?
: Imani never left me for dead, Arakawa.
: Imani wasn’t even employed here yet.
: Are you? Because I often find myself believing you’re some sort of homeless person who just wandered in that no one has bothered removing yet.
: Okay, I’m going to go to class now.
: Look at you, doing your best to play the role of a teacher. How cute.
: Anyway, if that’s all-
scene newsummerstuff7
: Wait.
: What now? I already told you I’d tell Imani about your estrogen filled bar night.
: This has nothing to do with estrogen.
: I have no idea if that’s a good thing or a bad thing.
: I was just wondering if you had any sort of interest in archery.
: That’s...a weird thing to wonder. And to plan on asking me about.
: It would be...if I was not the advisor for the school’s archery club.
: Am I being recruited right now?
: Not necessarily. But I can’t exactly move the way I used to. So if you’re able to look after the club on occasion when I’m unable to, I’d greatly appreciate it.
: Are you really sure I’m older than you? Because between that and those permanent bags beneath your eyes, I’m beginning to have my doubts.
: If you’re not interested, could you at least do me one other favor?
: Does it involve estrogen?
: It...actually does.
: Sure, Wakana. I’ll fuck your girlfriend.
scene newsummerstuff8
: Oh please. You wouldn’t know the first thing about what she likes.
: Vaginas and handcuffs.
: You wouldn’t know the third or fourth things about what she likes.
: I can figure them out.
: Arakawa.
: Fine. What do you actually want?
: I want you to keep my role as the archery club advisor to yourself...because if a certain brown-haired genius found out about it and joined the club, I would be forced to resign.
: Nodoka is still bothering you?
: That girl will chase me off the end of the sidewalk and into the abyss below.
: Then sure. I'll keep your secret safe.
: Thank-
: Under one condition.
: I will not allow you to bed my woman, Arakawa.
: I just want to know how old you are so we can settle this once and for all.
: And you’ll keep Nagasawa away if I tell you?
: I will...do my best.
scene newsummerstuff9
: Hah...
scene newsummerstuff5
: I’m 28 years old.
: God damnit. How do you look that tired at 28 years old?
: Misery takes its toll on the body rather viciously.
: You’re only one year younger than my famous idol ex-girlfriend, Niki Nakayama.
: Right. Your famous idol ex-girlfriend. I’ll be sure to tell my astronaut uncle and his panhandling capuchin monkey all about her.
: I’m not joking. I really did-
: Goodbye, Arakawa.
scene newsummerstuff1
: Oh, and if Miyamura is looking for a club to join, be sure to send her my way. A handful of your girls have already applied, so she wouldn’t be without friends.
: I’ll call Niki right now and-
: Give it up. You aren’t fooling anyone.
: Wakana, wait-
scene black
Meanwhile...
scene newsummerstuff10
: Yumi, you realize you’re literally the only person still wearing the old uniform, right? You can wear whatever you want now.
: You think I can afford a new one? You know I ain’t found a job yet.
: Yumi, they were literally free. I’m poor too, just in case you’ve forgotten.
scene newsummerstuff11
: Wait, you fuckin’ serious? How come you never told me?!
: Imani told everybody like a hundred times. I’m pretty sure even Sensei said it once or twice.
: You know I don’t listen to adults! And you also know that I don’t even normally come here to listen to them!
: In all fairness, neither of them are like normal adults. So I think you’d be able to listen to them without ruining the badass delinquent persona thing you’ve got going on.
scene newsummerstuff12
: God fucking damn it. Pretty soon you’re going to tell me some other shit that’s going to ruin my school life too and-
: You know you’ve also gotta sign up for a club by the end of the day, right?
scene newsummerstuff13
: What the fuck is going on today?!
: Relax, relax. I doubt you’ll ever have to show up or anything. It’s more of a...formality. Just sign up for something and go whenever you want to go. Which, knowing you...is never.
: I’ll just...sign up for whatever you sign up for. That way-
scene newsummerstuff14
: I don’t want you to be in the same club as me.
: You...what? Why the fuck not?
: A few reasons.
: First, if the two of us were in the same club and you actually decided to go to the meetings, it would make watching Chinami like, ten times harder since we wouldn’t be able to coordinate.
: Second, we already see each other like...75%% of every day.
: But third and most importantly...
: You’ve gotta leave the fucking nest, girl.
: The...what?
scene newsummerstuff15
: I mean you can’t just cling to me in social situations anymore! You’ve been taking baby steps, sure. Like...the whole apologizing to Futaba thing? That was awesome and I’m so proud of you.
: But you still won’t even show up to any of our parties without me pushing you to come...and you always ask to see my notes when there are tons of other people who’d love to help you.
: Can’t you at least try joining a club I’m not a part of? I can’t just be your fallback for everything, Yumi.
scene newsummerstuff16
: You’ve been hangin’ out with our fuckin’ schizoid teacher too much if even you’re gonna start lecturin’ me like this now.
: I’m not trying to lecture you! I’m trying to be a good friend.
: I love you, but I just...don’t want you living in my shadow anymore.
: I want you to pay attention to announcements...I want you to come to school and take your own notes...I want you to choose your own club.
: Yeah. But you’re forgettin’ the part where I don’t wanna do any of that shit.
scene newsummerstuff17
: Forgetting? Or ignoring?
: Oh, suck my dick.
scene newsummerstuff18
: Guess you’ve got a point, though. I just...ain’t really good at all that social shit. And I don’t even know what fuckin’ clubs we have here.
: I’m sure Makoto has a list if you want to go talk to her.
: Yeah, I’m sure she does too. But that would involve actually talkin’ to Makoto and I ain’t ready for that shit yet.
: The fuck club are you even joinin’ anyway? I ain’t ever heard you mention shit about clubs until today.
: It doesn’t matter what I’m doing. Just choose one for yourself and, if it actually winds up being the same one I’m in, I guess I can maybe...rethink being apart from you.
: But I’m not telling you which one I chose because I know it’ll impact your decision.
: Fucking damn it. This sucks.
: Yeah. Life sure is hard, huh?
: Was pretty okay until you decided you were gonna go all...whatever the fuck this is on me.
scene newsummerstuff19
: Yeah, well...
: There’s somebody I want to look good in front of now. Which means I don’t have all the time in the world to worry about looking out for you anymore.
: I’ll obvs still have your back if anything goes down, but...for the most part, I want you to do your own thing so I can do mine.
: I can handle Chinami. But another bigger, meaner Chinami on top of Chinami? Yeah, that I don’t have the time for right now.
: Yeah...
: Sounds like a huge fuckin’ Chinami.
scene newsummerstuff20
: For your sake, I really hope whatever club you join doesn’t involve comedy.
scene black
scene newsummerstuff21
: Yasu! You simply have to join the kyudo club with me!
: I understand that your arms may be too weak to properly handle a bow, but I’ve already consulted my mother and she’s agreed to hire an entire team of physical trainers to help fix that!
: Doesn’t that sound wonderful? You and I could be together for all hours of the day!
: He doesn’t like weapons.
: He? Who is he? Are you referring to Sensei? Because if you’d like to ask him for permission directly, I’d-
: He who sees but doesn’t. That which lurks. The one with many eyes.
scene newsummerstuff22
: Oh. Him.
: The path I must follow is a righteous one without bloodshed or violence.
: Man is not responsible enough to bear the power of God. And for that reason, we must never take up arms.
: My frailty has naught to do with it. I am simply trying to live a life free of sin.
: Summer has come, dearest Touka. He is all around us. Watching our every move. Judging our every decision.
: Yes, yes. He sounds quite wonderful, Yasu.
scene newsummerstuff23
: But do you know who else is wonderful?! Henmi Kiyomitsu, the creator of Kyūjutsu! And to think that it dates all the way back to the Heian period is just spectacular and-
: The one who awakens dates back to before time itself and could swallow Henmi Kiyomitsu whole.
scene newsummerstuff24
: Wait...does your god...eat people? Is that what makes him so wonderful?
: God would never do such a thing.
: But He could.
: It is His resistance and humbleness and the way He favors love before all else that makes Him so wonderful.
: And if He asks that I do not lay my hands on a weapon, I must follow His guidance.
: But...Yasu...you do realize that this decision will lead to us being apart, do you not?
scene newsummerstuff25
: Forever?...
: What? No. Not forever. Just for the duration of club.
scene newsummerstuff26
: I have already accepted that I will be with you always and forever and that, in the most humane way possible, you are a living doll that I am free to mold into a real, live human girl.
: Thank you, Touka. I have always dreamed of being a real, live human girl.
: They all smell so nice and breathe so quietly.
: Unfortunately, even with your guidance and His, I am still but the lowliest and flattest of worms. My existence here, while purposeful, is not enough to leave a mark on anyone but you.
: Well, that’s not true at all! In fact, Sana seems to be quite terrified of you! And while that isn’t exactly a good thing, it still means that you have left a mark!
: Will I be rewarded when I switch planes?
: I’m not sure what this talk about planes is, but if that is what you are after, I’d be delighted to show you my family’s private jet after school today.
scene newsummerstuff27
: Yes! Bring me closer to the sky so I can see the light!
: Okay! I’ll make some calls momentarily, but the jet has been grounded ever since Kumon-mi was isolated, so I’m not sure if we’ll be able to take off or not.
: Just being inside thick walls of metal is enough to make me feel closer to Him!
: I’ll say, your religion really is quite modern, isn’t it? I’ve never heard anything quite like that before.
scene newsummerstuff28
: If you heard the things I heard, you’d hear everything everywhere all at once.
: I do wonder just what club you will join then if not kyudo.
scene newsummerstuff23
: I’m sure you’ll do just fine, though! Everyone will love you once they see the real you!
: Do you remember the advice I gave you, Yasu? Because you’ll need to follow it very closely in order to succeed in life.
: I do!
: Remember to smile!
: That’s exactly right! Remember to smile! For, if you don’t-
scene happy3
scene happy4
scene happy5
scene newsummerstuff29
: Kendo Princess of...wherever we designated as your place of origin is!
: Tojo Ramen, home of the noodle.
: That was...definitely not it! But that is not what matters right now!
: That’s right! What matters is that you, Tsuneyo Tojo, join us-
: Molly and Ami! President and peon!
: In the school’s manga club!
scene newsummerstuff30
: Now, I know what you must be thinking. But for the purpose of this sales pitch, I will now have Ami read your mind. Ami, go!
: Noodles.
scene newsummerstuff31
: Get out of my head! The Tojo family’s secret recipes are in there!
: Read the other thing, Ami! Not the noodle part!
: Right, right...umm...uhh...it’s a little blurry, but...I think it’s saying...I want to join the manga club!
scene newsummerstuff32
: The girl with the nice legs knows my thoughts before even I do. How can this be?
: You see, Kendo Princess...the manga club isn’t all about manga...it is about companionship! Camaraderie! Cosplay! But most importantly...
scene newsummerstuff33
: It’s about comparing ships and then arguing with each other about it!
: Precisely!
: I have heard of this. I believe that is called a “yacht club.”
: Not that kind of ship, Kendo Princess! The kind with two characters who are meant to be together!
: As long as they are able to put aside their feelings while on the job, I am sure everything will be fine.
: But why do you want me in your yacht club? I know nothing about boats or manga.
: Not yet, you don’t! But you have been trying and that is all that matters!
: You see, manga club isn’t some elitist group of girls who will tell you what to watch and when-
: It’s a group of nerds who love nerd stuff and want to act like nerds in the same room as other nerds without being judged!
: It’s a group of great friends who support each other and cheer each other on when things get bad!
: It’s a group where we are all unified in one thing! The belief that One Piece has too many episodes!
: And a group where, no matter how hard I try, I can’t get anyone to watch Jojo’s Bizarre Adventure with me!
: Hey, I watched the whole first season with you, didn’t I?
scene newsummerstuff34
: Sure, I never kept going after that since it definitely wasn’t my cup of tea...but I tried, you know?
: Tsuneyo, this is the kind of ship we were talking about just now.
: Oh no. I forgot to buy a ticket.
: I don’t...
scene newsummerstuff35
: Can we talk?
: I don’t think it’ll take long, but...there are a few things I need to say and...well, I kind of need to say them before the day is over.
: You...want to talk to me?
: Do you really think I would have done something as awkward and uncomfortable as this if I didn’t?
: I obviously know shit’s weird for us right now and-
scene newsummerstuff36
: And, uhh...
: Umm...
: Actually...can we do this outside? Sensei won't care if we leave and...it’s not really something that I want other people listening in on.
: Y...Yeah.
: Yeah, we can talk. That’s fine.
: Can it be in the shade, though? The summer sun is cruel to this Irish skin and getting into spandex with sunburn is a horrible experience that I do not want to relive.
scene newsummerstuff37
: Yeah...I’m sure we can find somewhere with shade...
scene black
